5be6ef85f8c2eb9d.justification: Vesicle trafficking is not equivalent to any of the listed processes or molecular effects.

2688277f414eafac.justification: Synaptic vesicle clustering is distinct from SNARE assembly and the other candidate mechanisms.

de9df9309a0f0224.justification: Docking and priming jointly denotes two processes, broader than synaptic vesicle priming alone.

282ef99f3153fde0.justification: In this synaptic vesicle cycling context, fusion denotes vesicle fusion with the active zone membrane.

3d2cd42a05517d3e.justification: Re-uptake here refers to vesicle retrieval and recycling, not specifically GABA reuptake.

2005e91cafaea693.justification: SVC disorders is a multigene disease group, broader than any individual gene-defined candidate.

3611eef460b523de.justification: Movement disorders is a broad phenotype category not represented by any candidate.

9b78f6829481d517.justification: Epilepsies broadly does not identify any specific seizure type, EEG finding, or epilepsy complication listed.

84d73831537eb9d2.justification: Developmental delay is an alternative designation for the global developmental delay phenotype in this context.

d458afc43cf0c6cf.justification: Intellectual disabilities is the plural form of intellectual disability, without a severity qualifier.

34c4d56fd7e14565.justification: Autism is an alternative term associated with this HPO autistic behavior phenotype.

b0df6bf037b9948a.justification: No candidate represents attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.

1027200c9c582d5e.justification: None of the candidates represents psychiatric symptoms.

request_payload.title: The neurodevelopmental spectrum of synaptic vesicle cycling disorders.

mentions.sentence: Pathogenic variants in each SVC disorder gene lead to disturbance of at least one SVC subprocess, namely vesicle trafficking (e.g. KIF1A and GDI1), clustering (e.g. TRIO, NRXN1 and SYN1), docking and priming (e.g. STXBP1), fusion (e.g. SYT1 and PRRT2) or re-uptake (e.g. DNM1, AP1S2 and TBC1D24).

candidates.label: Synaptic vesicle fusion with the active zone membrane
candidates.summary: Fusion of the membrane of a synaptic vesicle with the presynaptic active zone membrane, thereby releasing its cargo neurotransmitters into the synaptic cleft.

candidates.label: Haploinsufficiency (one working copy is not enough)
candidates.summary: One of the two gene copies is lost or inactive, so the cell makes too little of a protein it needs. The remaining copy cannot cover the shortfall.

candidates.label: Protein destabilization / misfolding
candidates.summary: The variant protein is made but is unstable or misfolds, so it is degraded, aggregates, or is retained inside the cell instead of reaching its working location.

candidates.label: Ca2+-triggered neurotransmitter exocytosis
